title: Bias Scorer — Output Scored Cluster Record
description: One scored cluster per line in scored.jsonl. Inherits cluster identity from the input (cluster_id, label, label_type, member_hashes, member_count, source_ids, source_count) and adds: per-source bias enrichment, per-cluster bias_variance (stdev of atlanticist scores across cluster sources), and per-cluster axis_avg (5-axis fingerprint averaged across fingerprinted sources). Behaviour extracted verbatim from generate_feed.py:589-622 + :667-677.

bias_bucket.description: Left/center/right bucket for the Ground News coverage formula. From sources_global.json; defaults to 'center'.

bloc.description: Derived from atlanticist axis: >=0.5 → western, <0.3 → adversarial, else neutral (matches generate_feed.py:get_bloc).

atlanticist_norm.description: Atlanticist axis value normalised to [-10, +10] range via (val - 0.5) * 20 (matches generate_feed.py:get_atlanticist_score). null when source has no fingerprint.

bias_variance.description: Population stdev of atlanticist_norm values across cluster sources. 0.0 when <2 sources have fingerprints. Two-decimal rounded to match monolith output.

axis_avg.description: Five-axis cluster-level fingerprint averages. Each axis is the mean across cluster sources that carry a fingerprint for that axis; null when zero sources do. Three-decimal rounded to match monolith output.

fp_source_count.description: Maximum count across the five axes of sources contributing a value. Indicates how many cluster sources are fingerprinted; downstream code uses this to gate fingerprint-derived UI.
